Komentar: People are pretending that Prabowo is 45, but he is 75. Suharto was 76 when he resigned. Jokowi and his family have time on their side. Prabowo's government is a sinking ship because even if he moderates a lot of his policies, which he is doing now, The problem with a lot of political commentators is that political centralization is the easy part; if you want to go back to the Suharto Era, the more difficult part is economic/administrative recentralization. This is a comparison of the two systems. The problem is Prabowo tried to centralize things but doesn't have the political capital to reconstitute the old system. Going back to the old system is a major undertaking. And frankly, only the most senior bureaucrats in the Indonesian system know what it was like to operate under the old system, and that was only as junior staff. Prabowo has cut regional autonomy funds/village funds (dana desa). The problem is that the Central Government ministries no longer have Kanwils, so he is trying to set up a centralized system consisting of the following: Danatara, BUMN, Kopdes, SPPG, and an enlarged role for the military. This whole system is one stinking pile of crap. There was a reason why the Indonesian government during the New Order period was moving toward decentralization (Undang-Undang 5, 1974): because a lot of local issues weren't resolved, particularly with maintenance. The existing decentralized structure is based on the 1974 Law, which decentralized functions to kabupatan. The reason why the impact on the Indonesian economy is small, because the government budget is only 15% of Indonesia's GDP. You leave out stuff like defense; it's most likely 12-13%. Since it's only being moved around within the government, the macroeconomic impact is small. However, the big impact is at the micro level. When you cut funding for emergencies, like flood control and the haze. Prabowo Wants Benefits of Centralization Without Micromanagement The centralized New Order system was designed to suit someone like Suharto, who grew into the system starting when he was 44. Prabowo isn't even willing to do what Jokowi was doing; how can he manage a system that was even more demanding: the centralized New Order administrative structure?
